data.title: Is Bitcoin’s Bear Market Over? Galaxy Thinks It Might Be
data.description: Galaxy Digital just declared the crypto winter over and told clients to buy Bitcoin now, but the price keeps sliding lower while major traders bet against it. Something does not add up.
